# Local Coffee Shops

> A community-driven directory for discovering local, independent coffee shops across all 50 US states.

Local Coffee Shops (https://localcoffeeshop.co) is a free directory that helps people find independent, neighborhood coffee shops and cafes across the United States. Listings are community-submitted and can be searched by name or city, and filtered by state and price level.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://localcoffeeshop.co/): Search and browse coffee shops by state.
- [About](https://localcoffeeshop.co/about.html): Who we are and our mission to support local coffee shops.
- [Submit a shop](https://localcoffeeshop.co/submit.html): Add a local coffee shop to the directory.
- [Contact](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/contact.html): Get in touch with the team.
- [Coffee roasters](https://localcoffeeshop.co/roasters/): A curated, non-exhaustive list of coffee roasters that sell packaged beans on their own websites, starting with Massachusetts and New England. Each entry links to the roaster's official site and bean shop, with the pages used as sources and the date they were checked; shipping and pickup are shown only where the roaster's site states them.

## Browse by state

All 50 US states, plus Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, are covered. Each state has a page listing its coffee shops, at `https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/{state}.html` where `{state}` is the lowercase, hyphenated state name. Pages are regenerated from the live directory on each deploy. For example:

- [California](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/california.html)
- [New York](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/new-york.html)
- [Texas](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/texas.html)
- [Florida](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/florida.html)
- [Washington](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/washington.html)
- [Oregon](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/oregon.html)
- [Illinois](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/illinois.html)
- [Colorado](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/colorado.html)
- [Massachusetts](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/massachusetts.html)
- [Pennsylvania](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/pennsylvania.html)

All states are listed on the [states index](https://localcoffeeshop.co/pages/states/) and in the [sitemap](https://localcoffeeshop.co/sitemap.xml).

## About the data

Coffee shop listings are community-submitted by coffee enthusiasts and shop owners. Each listing includes the shop's name, address, and price level. The directory is maintained to help coffee lovers discover and support independent local cafes.
